title: Positive exactness of the sheafified free presheaf Čech nerve
statement: Let C have morphisms in universe v, let J be a Grothendieck topology, and assume abelian sheafification exists [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For any arrow f:E→P of v-valued presheaves of sets, form A_n=(Z[N_n(f)])# with the alternating-face differential [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex]. Then A is exact at n+1 for every natural n. No local-surjectivity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01GC, Lemma 25.4.2 and its proof; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GC.

proof.text: For any set map factor through its set-theoretic image. The inclusion is monic, so the wide-pullback universal properties give an isomorphism between the two nerves; nerveMonoIso constructs it and checks its naturality. The surjection onto the image has a right inverse by the proved choice theorem Function.Surjective.hasRightInverse. Mathlib Arrow.AugmentedCechNerve.extraDegeneracy, ExtraDegeneracy.map with AddCommGrpCat.free, and ExtraDegeneracy.homotopyEquiv give a homotopy equivalence with the free image group concentrated in degree zero. HomotopyEquiv.toHomologyIso and exactAt_iff_isZero_homology show exactness in every positive degree. All of this is proved in type_nerve_positive_exact, including the empty case.

Evaluation preserves finite limits. In nerveMapIso, preservesLimitIso and HasLimit.isoOfNatIso construct the comparison of the evaluated nerve with the nerve of the evaluated arrow; the projection and base equations prove naturality. Jointly faithful evaluation functors detect exactness by Mathlib JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.exact_iff. map_alternatingFaceMapComplex commutes evaluation with alternating faces. Hence the presheaf complex is exact in positive degrees; presheaf_nerve_positive_exact proves the claim.

Sheafification is exact and additive [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact]. Map the proved presheaf short complexes by presheafToSheaf, then use map_alternatingFaceMapComplex to identify the result with the sheafified nerve complex.

from.place: Second paragraph, via the presheaf-nerve vanishing criterion: augmented free nerve and its Hom comparison. This node isolates positive exactness of the sheafified free presheaf čech nerve.

lean.statement:
theorem presheafCechSheaf_positive_exact
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}] (f : Arrow (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)) :
  let F := (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj AddCommGrpCat.free ⋙
    presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat
  let A := (AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex _).obj (f.cechNerve ⋙ F)
  ∀ n : ℕ, A.ExactAt (n + 1)
